how: Calls recruit members to complete a flag, enlarge it, and help a smaller symbol project.
A participant explicitly doubts that enough people are available for the proposed flag size.
The revised starter role fits a member proposing a flag transformation and beginning to paint without requiring subsequent uptake.
Bare replies explicitly join a proposed change or report for duty.
A conversion proposal receives a bare acceptance while acceptance expressed only through placing remains outside observation.
Recruitment and completion reports establish sequence without measuring how many placers the calls brought.
A proposed start and uptake do not establish the starter causing a distinct subsequent recruitment campaign.
Members answer coordinate questions and explain how to obtain a shareable pixel link.
Internal criticism is visible in an insulting refusal of delegate candidature while apology, departure, and quarrel repair remain unobserved.
Members propose local words, lettering, hearts, and historical emblems while continuing to revise what the work should show.
Participants report a flag apparently finished and a heart completed within continuing project work.
Coordinate answers, redirects, and pixel links make current work findable.
Posting a specification settles design only where placers accept its target rather than repeatedly undoing enlargement.
Members invite helpers to a planning chat, route arrivals to its current-target channel, and report ongoing canvas discussion there.
A shared script draws while its tab remains open and is adjusted amid competing enlargement efforts.
Timed collective pixel blasts establish coordinated human placing rather than machine use unless automation is separately evidenced.
An eleven-minute pixel blast proposes simultaneous human placing within a theme that also contains scripts.
Protection and reshaping are stated script purposes while exhaustion of manual placement capacity remains unverified.
Participants explicitly weigh waiting for rivals to sleep against their own matching sleep schedule.
An open-tab requirement and timed placing do not establish reported site faults or fixes.
A joking sanction and contested delegate request leave enforceable canvas command unresolved and cannot test the model's aggregate frequency claim.
Members restore outlines, respond to overwriting text, and return to maintenance after expansion.
One speaker explicitly reports enlargement completed and a return to maintaining the work.
Reversal of enlargement does not establish uninformed repairers or an agreed plan, because deliberate disagreement remains possible.
A participant attributes the flag's cramped proportions to another participant's early frame-building.
Maintenance and diplomacy co-occur while the clearest explicit settlement follows an attack and warning rather than an evidenced erosion-driven approach.
Visitors ask to discuss cooperation and report agreements while local participants report talks and changes of target.
Members carry alliance invitations and returning communiques between rooms or report having conducted talks.
A rejected request to become a delegate does not establish enacted inter-room representation.
The supported instance contests delegate eligibility without establishing that members reject a treaty's authority over all placers.
The revised post-agreement bound is not met by a delegate dispute that identifies no preceding agreement.
Participants ask others to stop stealing a flag and report halting attacks after talks.
One report explicitly names neighbour talks and restraint while actual universal compliance and durability remain unresolved.
A diplomatic warning during an attack episode is followed by reported talks and instructions to stop attacking.
A neighbour offers protection in return, establishing proposed reciprocal help without establishing delivery.
Bargaining supports proposed protection rather than proving that reciprocal pixels were delivered.
A protection offer and separate rebuilding effort do not establish a maintenance shortage causing actual incoming help.
Alliance invitations and joint-mark calls establish coalition recruiting while acceptance and joint defence remain unobserved.
Invitations and defence concerns leave actual coalition participation and shared-chat decisions outside this record.
Members redirect ongoing work toward smaller flags and available space without stating a loss-triggered relocation.
Loss reports and new coordinates do not supply a stated decision to relocate because the work was lost.
Doubt about available hands does not establish shortage-driven relocation.
A protection offer does not establish an Austrian guest work living under a neighbour's territorial rules.
Participants criticise attacking existing art rather than creating original work in unused space.
A visitor identifying as Polish does not establish dual membership or divided loyalty.
Historical jokes and a familiar weekly complaining ritual supply existing language and practices for canvas activity.
Members turn competing designs and a moderator's weekly-thread threat into new jokes that others answer.
A participant rejects a recurring swastika and proposes covering it without documenting successful removal.
Historical and patriotic framing names a target without independently establishing an inherited tie as the reason that target was selected.
Historical jokes and a reunion proposal do not establish an inherited quarrel driving the canvas contest.
Later reports establish an event-specific external group within an existing community while its precise founding and member-recruitment mechanism remain unseen.

statement: correcting the wording of a recruitment call
how: Ordinary grammar correction remains a local event-thread practice without a demonstrated effect on recruitment.
A member explicitly appreciates the local transit April Fools joke alongside canvas activity.
A weekend thread is opened explicitly to curb the sprawl of canvas threads.
Participants describe canvas posts flooding the host and weigh whether an existing chat makes another venue unnecessary.
A member contests flag work by calling for beautiful projects, background cleaning, and new pixel art.
A familiar host ritual becomes a joking stake for mobilisation without establishing actual cancellation or enforcement.
Flood complaints do not establish attacking the room's own mark because of canvas posts.
Members celebrate involvement and briefly declare the eagle just right before final closure.
A later title recollects the eagle's briefly satisfactory state.
Completion reports and celebrations concern particular accomplishments rather than establishing one final room-wide ritual.
Celebration followed by recollection establishes sequence without establishing that celebration caused an archival programme.
Members approve repurposing the event chat and report closing a placeholder and redirecting its idlers.
Retention is explained through an available organising venue and replaceable placeholder while a record-driven retention decision remains unverified.
A venue reported as hosting event planning is explicitly proposed for ordinary community life after placement ends.
Post-event chat reuse and earlier recollection of a design do not establish disputes about cleaned copies or authoritative event history.
A claim of being the largest external community does not identify canvas-driven arrivals or their reception.
Design references to a local figure or a historical ruler do not establish seeking outside recognition.
Members propose converting neighbouring flags and explicitly call for annexation or destruction.
A recruitment turn gives coordinates, calls everyone in, and immediately raises action against a neighbouring flag.
The conversion contest becomes a named war and a report of near conquest.
A conversion proposal receives a hostile reply explicitly signed by the target community.
An explicit stop-stealing request refuses the attack without the extended reason the mechanism generally expects.
An evasive public answer to a visiting questioner supports joking misdirection without establishing espionage or successful concealment.
Conversion can exploit opponents maintaining existing stripes while attackers add a stripe and later erase the boundary.
Intended attack does not establish successful conversion when participants report accidentally enlarging the target's flag.
